Priya: Auditor asked for proof that the RBAC change merged on 2026-02-10 was authorized, plus KMS access logs for the service account that performed the deploy. Can someone assemble a minimal evidence bundle? @Jamal @Ava
Jamal: On it. Which change/PR ID? I can pull PR diff, approvals, and CI run details.
Priya: PR #4578. They also want the authorization trail (Okta approval + GitHub review) and the emergency access entries during the vuln triage on Feb 12. Keep PII redacted.
Ava: We have CloudKMS and CloudAudit logs for the service account. Question — do they want raw logs or filtered snippets? Auditor usually prefers raw events but we can provide both with redaction notes.
Jamal: I'll prepare a zipped bundle and drop into the evidence S3 bucket. Plan: PR diff, screenshots of approvals, Okta session export, cloudkms log snippet, CI job logs, and a README mapping artifacts to controls. Naming: `s3://redwood-evidence/2026-02-rbac-4578-bundle.zip`.
Priya: Include a control mapping README that maps each file to SOC2/ISO controls (e.g., CC6.2, A.9.x) and include SHA256 hashes for each artifact. Also add a redaction_manifest.txt describing fields redacted.
compliance-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/2026-02-rbac-4578-bundle.zip — presigned link generated (expires in 7d) :white_check_mark:
Jamal: Presigned link posted to auditor DM. Commands I ran to verify download: 
```bash
aws s3 cp --profile redwood s3://redwood-evidence/2026-02-rbac-4578-bundle.zip ./
sha256sum 2026-02-rbac-4578-bundle.zip
```
I also signed the README: `gpg --detach-sign README.md`
auditor_jess: Thanks. A couple quick Qs: 1) Does the KMS log include the exact key resource name used by the service account? 2) Can you provide the KMS key rotation history?
Ava: Yes — CloudKMS entries include `requestParameters.keyName` and `authenticationInfo.principalEmail`. Rotation is enabled; last scheduled rotation occurred 2025-10-05. I'll export rotation history CSV and attach to the bundle.
Priya: Action items: 1) Jamal — redact IPs from audit logs, add `redaction_manifest.txt` and the small Python script used to redact. 2) Ava — rotation CSV + raw KMS events. Target: deliver final bundle by EOD PST tomorrow.
Jamal: Ack. I'll add `redact_ips.py` to the bundle and include the script header: 
```python
# redact_ips.py — replaces IPv4/IPv6 patterns with <REDACTED_IP>
# usage: python redact_ips.py input.log > redacted.log
```
auditor_jess: If you can also include the CI run id that actually applied the deploy (so we can link approval -> deployment), that would close the loop.
Jamal: CI run id `8923` was the deploy. Added `ci-8923-deploy-log.txt` to the archive.
Priya: Great. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall or me directly. Thanks everyone — this should satisfy the evidence request and the auditor Q&A.
